json.name: exposure_metrics
json.description: Market exposure by counterparty, instrument and book. Synthetic demo data.
json.nativeDefinition:
# A Databricks Unity Catalog metric view over the finance demo tables (finance_model.py), written to exercise every
# part of the Metric View -> SemanticModel/Metric mapping (ING-2946). Synthetic data; no customer names.
#
# What it covers:
#   joins          positions -> counterparty, positions -> instrument -> issuer (a nested join)
#   dimensions     with display_name and synonyms, one per joined table, plus a date
#   measures       plain aggregates with format, a composable MEASURE() ratio, and a window measure
#   filter         a top-level filter
#   materialization
#
# Create it with create_metric_view.sql (needs CREATE TABLE in a Unity Catalog schema; metric views don't exist in
# hive_metastore). The tables it reads must be in Unity Catalog too: setup copies them there.
version: 1.1

comment: "Market exposure by counterparty, instrument and book. Synthetic demo data."

source: main.markets.pos_eod

filter: mv_usd IS NOT NULL

joins:
  - name: cpty
    source: main.markets.cpty_mstr
    on: source.cpty_id = cpty.cpty_id
  - name: instr
    source: main.markets.instr_ref
    on: source.instr_id = instr.instr_id
    joins:
      - name: issuer
        source: main.markets.cpty_mstr
        on: instr.issuer_cpty_id = issuer.cpty_id

dimensions:
  - name: jurisdiction
    expr: cpty.ctry_cd
    comment: "Country whose law the counterparty is organized under."
    display_name: "Counterparty jurisdiction"
    synonyms: ["country", "domicile"]
  - name: counterparty
    expr: cpty.legal_nm
    display_name: "Counterparty"
  - name: asset_class
    expr: instr.asset_cls_cd
    display_name: "Asset class"
    synonyms: ["product type"]
  - name: issuer_jurisdiction
    expr: instr.issuer.ctry_cd
    comment: "Country of the instrument's issuer (through the nested join)."
  - name: book
    expr: source.book_cd
    display_name: "Trading book"
  - name: cob_date
    expr: source.cob_dt
    display_name: "Close of business"

measures:
  - name: market_value
    expr: SUM(source.mv_usd)
    comment: "Mark-to-market value in USD."
    display_name: "Market value (USD)"
    synonyms: ["exposure", "MTM"]
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: USD
  - name: notional
    expr: SUM(source.ntnl_amt)
    display_name: "Notional"
  - name: position_count
    expr: COUNT(1)
    display_name: "Positions"
  - name: avg_market_value
    expr: MEASURE(market_value) / MEASURE(position_count)
    comment: "Composable: built from two other measures, so it should get derivedFrom edges to both."
    display_name: "Average position value"
  - name: market_value_trailing_5d
    expr: SUM(source.mv_usd)
    comment: "Window measure over the last five close-of-business dates."
    window:
      - order: cob_date
        range: trailing 5 day
        semiadditive: last

materialization:
  schedule: every 6 hours
  mode: relaxed
  materialized_views:
    - name: by_jurisdiction
      type: aggregated
      dimensions: [jurisdiction, cob_date]
      measures: [market_value, position_count]
